Standard: The air vehicle meets the flight in icing conditions standard as specified in 14 CFR 23.2165, and the applicable flight in icing conditions requirements in 14 CFR 25; unless pilot evaluation determines the air vehicle handling qualities are no worse than Level 2 with ice accretion on the lifting surfaces (wings, tails) during and after flight through icing conditions. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the air vehicle flying qualities in icing conditions as specified in 14 CFR 23.2165, and applicable flight in icing conditions requirements in 14 CFR 25 for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and icing conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the air vehicle handling qualities in icing conditions as specified in 14 CFR 23.2165, and applicable flight in icing conditions requirements in 14 CFR 25 for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and icing conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the air vehicle handling qualities in icing conditions as specified in 14 CFR 23.2165, and applicable flight in icing conditions requirements in 14 CFR 25 for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and icing conditions.
